name: STACK
author: Alwaro777
tagline: a rave groovebox whose sound system grows as you build the track
description: STACK turns the FM-1 into an 8-track groovebox for rave, dub and acid. Every track you add brings a speaker cabinet to the stack on screen: subs at the bottom, mids in the middle, tops on top. Beta: install at your own risk.
